items.title: Albert Warner Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: I used to like his playing, because everywhere he was playing I would be there. I heard him. But I didn't have no interest in no music then, you see, back in those days.

ctx.x: Did you hear, remember Oliver playing here?

Oh, yeah. I used to go dance for Oliver's music. He used to play around here at the Economy Hall. Yeah, I used to be at him and, was that the fellow here in California now? Kid Ori? Ori? Yeah. That's when Oliver left here. I was at the last dance he played over at the Economy Hall.
How did Ori play? Was he a head man or read much or pretty rough or a nice tone?
